summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Calamos Tax-Aware Collateral ETF (CBOX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is actively managed, investing in a portfolio of box spreads referencing the S&P 500 ETF (SPY). It seeks capital appreciation. CBOX was launched on Apr 17, 2026 and is issued by Calamos.
